newsitem.title: JAPAN: Southern Japan shaken by strong tremor.
newsitem.headline: Southern Japan shaken by strong tremor.

text.p: Wide areas of Japan's southern island of Kyushu were rocked by a strong earthquake on Tuesday, Japanese officials said.
There was no immediate indication of its magnitude.
The earthquake registered 6.1 on the Richter scale and was centred in Kagoshima prefecture, NHK public broadcasting reported.
There was no danger of tidal waves from the earthquake and no immediate reports of damage, NHK said.
